description: This file defines the ConceptSet class, representing a single concept within a concept set in the OpenMRS medical records system. It includes data fields such as concept, parent concept, sort weight, creator, and date created, as well as methods for accessing and manipulating these fields. The class implements interfaces for auditing and comparison, and extends a base OpenMRS object.

classes.name: ConceptSet
classes.description: Represents a concept within a concept set, with properties such as concept, parent concept, sort weight, creator, and timestamps for creation. Implements comparison based on retired status and sort weight.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this concept set.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this concept set.

methods.name: getConceptSet
methods.description: Returns the parent concept that uses this set.

methods.name: setConceptSet
methods.description: Sets the parent concept that uses this set.

methods.name: getSortWeight
methods.description: Returns the sort weight for ordering.

methods.name: setSortWeight
methods.description: Sets the sort weight for ordering.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created this concept set.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the user who created this concept set.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the creation date of this concept set.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of this concept set.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this concept set object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of this concept set object.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last changed the object (not currently used).

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the last change date (not currently used).

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last changed the object (no-op).

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ConceptSet with another, ordering by concept's retired status and then by sort weight.
